a, b, m = map(int, input().split())

def gcd_func(x, y):
    return x if y == 0 else gcd_func(y, x % y)

min_diff = 1e9
ans_num = 0
ans_den = 1

if b <= m:
    g = gcd_func(a, b)
    while g > 1:
        a //= g
        b //= g
        g = gcd_func(a, b)
    print(f"{a}/{b}")
else:
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        g = gcd_func(i, b)
        h = a * i // g
        w = a * (h // b)
        diff1 = abs(w - ((w // (h // i)) * (h // i))) / h
        if min_diff > diff1:
            min_diff = diff1
            ans_num = w // (h // i)
            ans_den = i
        numerator = w + (h // i) - 1
        denominator = h // i
        diff2 = abs(w - ((numerator // denominator) * denominator)) / h
        if min_diff > diff2:
            min_diff = diff2
            ans_num = numerator // denominator
            ans_den = i
    g = gcd_func(ans_num, ans_den)
    ans_num //= g
    ans_den //= g
    print(f"{ans_num}/{ans_den}")
